description: Twelve rate/profile candidates plus R00/W85/W115 comparison controls; exploratory only.

competitors.label: Baja reference
competitors.intent: Unchanged reference hardware; the common point of comparison.

competitors.label: Tip hardware 85%
competitors.intent: Change centrifugal closing and its consistent inertia together; spring and geometry unchanged. Higher/lower working speed is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed performance gain.

competitors.label: Tip hardware 115%
competitors.intent: Change centrifugal closing and its consistent inertia together; spring and geometry unchanged. Higher/lower working speed is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed performance gain.

competitors.label: Primary spring rate 0.5x
competitors.intent: Softer return spring: less increase in opposition with primary closure; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Primary spring rate 2x
competitors.intent: Stiffer return spring: greater increase in opposition across the shift; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Primary spring rate 3x
competitors.intent: Strong rate contrast; test rising work-speed characteristic and possible incomplete shift; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Secondary spring rate 0.5x
competitors.intent: Softer secondary compression spring with matched initial closing force; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Secondary spring rate 2x
competitors.intent: Stiffer secondary compression spring with matched initial closing force; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Torsional spring rate 0.666667x
competitors.intent: Softer torsional spring with matched initial torque; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Torsional spring rate 1.5x
competitors.intent: Stiffer torsional spring with matched initial torque; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 10 deg
competitors.intent: Keep first 10 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 10 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 28 deg
competitors.intent: Keep first 10 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 28 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Ramp straight tail 30 deg
competitors.intent: Keep first 10 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a straight tail ending at 30 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 35 deg late
competitors.intent: Keep first 18 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 35 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 40 deg late
competitors.intent: Keep first 18 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 40 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.
